summary: Sample frames of a clip at given fractions of its own duration, fit each into one cell and hstack them into a single image. Geometry in, one picture out.

parity.note: One ffmpeg invocation whose argv is a pure function of (params, measured duration), decoding the same input bytes on a pinned build — the same condition media.scale states. tests/test_op_media_filmstrip.py asserts the argv directly, so a tuning drift shows as an argv diff instead of as a different picture in front of a judge. No `flags=` is set on the scaler ON PURPOSE: the strip is read by a vision model, and its pixels must not change on the day the work moved off the box. FAILURE: `strip` is OPTIONAL — a frame that will not render leaves no file rather than raising, because one chain carries a whole batch and a raising handler would let one unreadable clip kill every sibling. A malformed PARAM still raises, in milliseconds.

positions.description: Where to sample, as fractions of the clip's OWN duration. A GEOMETRY, the same class of fact as `width` — and the hard line of this op: no frame-SELECTION rule may ever appear in these params. Nothing here may say 'pick the most dynamic frame', 'sample denser near the in-point', or carry a motion threshold; anything of that shape is computed on the brain and arrives already collapsed into numbers. There is no separate `count`: the number of cells IS len(positions), and a second source for it would be a drift surface, not a convenience.

width.description: Cell width in pixels. The image is width x len(positions) wide.

height.description: Cell height in pixels. Width:height is also the crop aspect under fit=cover.

fit.description: How a frame meets the cell. `cover` centre-crops to the cell aspect — the real full-bleed framing a viewer sees. `contain` letterboxes on the pad colour. `contain_alpha` letterboxes on TRANSPARENCY, for art whose backplate cannot be chosen here: ffmpeg cannot read the art's luminance, so a tone baked into the pad forces one polarity on every mark and a dark mark on a dark pad is an empty cell. Geometry, not intent: WHICH one an asset gets is decided on the brain and crosses as one enum value, never as the rule that produced it.
